Quick recap:

- Ask from MedNova: network isolation requirements, evidence for SOC2/GDPR posture, and feasibility of an air-gapped deployment for PHI workloads.

1) We’ll share a vendor questionnaire and a simple deployment sketch for your network team to review (attached).
2) Please confirm which compliance controls you need proof for first (SOC 2 Type II evidence, GDPR DPA, HIPAA BAAs).

4) We’ll list the minimum evidence items (SOC report section, encryption at rest/transit, KMS/HSM approach, logging/audit retention).

Timing: we can deliver questionnaire + initial sketch by EOD today; ready to join a follow-up earliest Tue 7/14.

Hannah — thanks for the recap and for jumping on this so quickly. A few clarifications from our side: 

- SOC 2: we completed SOC 2 Type I last quarter; Type II is currently in progress with an expected completion window in Q4. For procurement, we typically accept SOC 2 Type I + evidence of controls in place while Type II completes.
- GDPR / HIPAA: our workload is mixed. PHI must remain under HIPAA controls; non-PHI EU workloads need GDPR data residency assurances. We’ll need a DPA and BAA draft.
- Air-gapped option: this is a hard requirement for one internal POC (offline model serving, no egress). We need to understand whether Redwood supports an air-gapped on-prem package or if a private VPC with strict egress controls is the closest fit.

Can you attach the questionnaire and sketch here? Also please include an expected list of evidence items (we’ll map them to our internal audit).

If possible, copy our procurement/security contact on the next thread: procurement@mednova.com. Samir — feel free to jump in if I missed anything.

Best,
Elena Ruiz
Head of Security & Compliance | MedNova Health

Thanks — quick clarifying Qs before we commit to timeline: 

1) KMS / key management: for the air-gapped option do you support HSM integration (on-prem HSM) or only cloud KMS? We need assurance that keys never leave our boundary for PHI workloads.
2) Audit logs & retention: what format and retention options do you provide for private deployments (syslog export, S3, or local immutable storage)? We need evidence for our auditors.
3) Model updates: you mentioned manual transfer — can you detail the mechanics (signed artifacts, checksum verification, allowed protocols)?

If you can answer these at a high level we can decide whether to fill the questionnaire first or schedule the network call. Ideally we do both in parallel.
